answer_1.quote: The generation tasks require concluding the moral of a story (ST2MO for short), and conversely generating a coherent story to convey a moral (MO2ST for short).
answer_1.outputs: Generated moral text (ST2MO) or generated story text (MO2ST)

answer_2.quote: We adopt the following metrics for automatic evaluation: (1) BLEU (B-n)... (2) BERTScore-F1 (BS)... (3) Repetition (R-n)... (4) Distinct (D-n)... For MO2ST we also adopt Coverage (Cov) and Order (Ord).

answer_4.quote: We conducted a Likert-scale based manual evaluation... we require three annotators to rate its quality along with the input using a binary score in three following aspects: (1) linguistic fluency... (2) coherence... (3) moral faithfulness.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to rate each generated text on fluency, coherence, and moral faithfulness using binary scores.
